{{< include 2_Analysis_Foundation/s1_AnalysisFunctions.qmd >}}
{{< include 2_Analysis_Foundation/s2_Test.qmd >}}

```{=html}
<aside id="active-section-nav"></aside>

<script>
(function() {
  const sections = [];
  const h2List = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("h2")).filter(h => !h.closest("#TOC"));

  function printSingleSection(nodes) {
    const toHide = [];
    const toc = document.getElementById("TOC");
    const header = document.getElementById("title-block-header");
    if (toc) toHide.push(toc);
    if (header) toHide.push(header);

    const parent = nodes.at(0).parentElement;
    Array.from(parent.children).forEach(child => {
      if (!nodes.includes(child)) toHide.push(child);
    });

    toHide.forEach(el => el.classList.add("print-hide"));
    window.print();
    setTimeout(() => {
      toHide.forEach(el => el.classList.remove("print-hide"));
    }, 500);
  }

  h2List.forEach((h2) => {
    const sectionNodes = [h2];
    const subLinks = [];
    let el = h2.nextElementSibling;
    let lastEl = h2;

    while (el && el.tagName !== "H2" && el.tagName !== "H1") {
      sectionNodes.push(el);
      if (el.tagName === "H3" && el.id) {
        subLinks.push({ id: el.id, text: el.textContent });
      }
      lastEl = el;
      el = el.nextElementSibling;
    }

    const footer = document.createElement("div");
    footer.className = "section-footer";
    footer.style.gap = "0.75rem";

    const printBtn = document.createElement("button");
    printBtn.type = "button";
    printBtn.className = "back-toc";
    printBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";
    printBtn.style.fontFamily = "inherit";
    printBtn.textContent = "🖨️ Print Section PDF";
    printBtn.addEventListener("click", () => printSingleSection(sectionNodes));

    const backLink = document.createElement("a");
    backLink.href = "#TOC";
    backLink.className = "back-toc";
    backLink.textContent = "↑ Back to Contents";

    footer.appendChild(printBtn);
    footer.appendChild(backLink);
    lastEl.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", footer);

    sections.push({ h2, subLinks, nodes: sectionNodes });
  });

  const sideNav = document.getElementById("active-section-nav");
  let activeSection = null;

  function updateSideNav() {
    if (!sections.length) return;

    if (sections.at(0).h2.getBoundingClientRect().top > 220) {
      sideNav.style.opacity = "0";
      sideNav.style.pointerEvents = "none";
      return;
    }

    let current = sections.at(0);
    const atBottom = (window.innerHeight + window.scrollY) >= (document.body.offsetHeight - 40);

    if (atBottom) {
      current = sections.at(-1);
    } else {
      for (const sec of sections) {
        if (sec.h2.getBoundingClientRect().top <= 220) {
          current = sec;
        }
      }
    }

    activeSection = current;

    if (current.subLinks.length) {
      const items = current.subLinks
        .map(l => '<a href="#' + l.id + '">' + l.text + '</a>')
        .join("");
      sideNav.innerHTML = '<div class="side-title">In This Section</div>' + items +
        '<div style="margin-top:0.6rem; padding-top:0.5rem; border-top:1px solid #1e293b; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.4rem;">' +
        '<a href="#TOC" style="color:var(--neon-blue); font-weight:600; margin:0;">↑ Course Contents</a>' +
        '<a href="#" id="side-print-btn" style="color:#10b981; font-weight:600; margin:0;">🖨️ Print Section PDF</a>' +
        '</div>';
      sideNav.style.opacity = "1";
      sideNav.style.pointerEvents = "auto";

      document.getElementById("side-print-btn").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (activeSection) printSingleSection(activeSection.nodes);
      });
    } else {
      sideNav.style.opacity = "0";
      sideNav.style.pointerEvents = "none";
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener("scroll", updateSideNav, { passive: true });
  updateSideNav();
})();
</script>
```
